This is a corrected transcription of the hieroglyphic text from page 18 of E.A. Wallis Budge’s *Egyptian Reading Book* (1896).

### === CORRECTED HIEROGLYPHS ===

1. 𓂋 𓆓 𓃹 𓈖 𓈎 𓏏 𓂋 𓏤 𓇋 𓅓 𓏏 𓅱 𓏏 𓁷 𓂋 𓂓 𓏏 𓈖 𓎡 𓅱 𓂝 𓈖 𓎛 𓃀 𓅱 𓈖 𓎛 𓈎 𓏏 𓁷 𓂋 𓆓 𓏏 𓎡
2. 𓇋 𓅓 𓏏 𓅱 𓆑 𓁷 𓂋 𓁹 𓋴 𓏏 𓆑 𓈗 𓅓 𓁹 𓊢 𓂝 𓄡 𓂋 𓇳 𓇋 𓅱 𓆑 𓁷 𓂋 𓆣 𓅱
3. 𓅓 𓂝 𓎡 𓃹 𓈖 𓂜 𓈖 𓆑 𓁷 𓂋 𓋴 𓅓 𓇋 𓇋 𓏥
4. 𓈖 𓆑 𓂋 𓏏 𓄿 𓇋 𓈖 𓏏 𓅯 𓄿 𓂝 𓈙 𓇋 𓅱 𓅯 𓄿 𓇋 𓆑 𓋴 𓈖 𓂝 𓄿
5. 7. 𓁷 𓂋 𓋴 𓅓 𓇋 𓇋 𓏥 𓈖 𓆑 𓂋 𓅯 𓄿 𓇋 𓆑 𓅯 𓄿 𓇋 𓅱 𓆓 𓏏 𓆑 𓅱 𓄿 𓎛 𓁷 𓂋 𓁶 𓏤 𓆑
6. 𓇋 𓅱 𓆑 𓅱 𓂋 𓎛 𓅱 𓈖 𓄿 𓅱 𓏏 𓈖 𓏏 𓋴 𓐠 𓂋 𓏤 𓁹 𓈖 𓆑 𓂋 𓅯 𓄿
7. 𓇋 𓆑 𓇋 𓅱 𓆑 𓁷 𓂋 𓄡 𓏏 𓄃 𓆑 8. 𓏏 𓄿 𓇋 𓆑 𓈞 𓏏 𓁐 𓇋 𓅱 𓋴 𓁷 𓂋 𓄡 𓄿 𓄿 𓋴 𓏏
8. 𓈖 𓄿 𓈖 𓇋 𓅱 𓅱 𓇋 𓅱 𓆑 𓈞 𓋴 𓅓 𓎡 𓄿 𓋴 𓄿 𓈖 𓅯 𓄿 𓇋 𓆑 𓋴 𓈖 𓈙 𓂋 𓇋 𓅱 𓏥
9. 𓄡 𓂋 𓁹 𓅓 𓐍 𓏏 𓇳 𓈎 𓈖 𓈖 𓅱 𓁷 𓏤 𓋴 𓐠 𓈖 𓈖 𓇋 𓅱 𓅯 𓄿 𓇋 𓆑 𓋴 𓈖
10. 𓈙 𓂋 𓇋 𓅱 𓏥 𓅓 𓏏 𓄿 𓇋 𓈖 𓏏 𓅯 𓄿 𓂝 𓈙 9. [𓇋] 𓅱 𓂜 𓈖

### === TRANSLITERATION ===

er ṭeṭ unu neket er-ȧ emtutu ḥer ṭāt-nek uā en ɵebu en ḥeqt ḥer ṭet-k
emtuf ḥer ȧri setef em ȧri āḥā ẖer rā ȧu-f ḥer ḫeperu emmā-k un ȧn-f
7 ḥer śemi- 7. nef er ta ȧnt pa āš ȧu paif sen āa ḥer śemi-nef er paif
pa ȧu ṭet-f uaḥ ḥer ṭaṭa-f ȧu-f urḥu en āuṭent sper pu ȧri-nef er paif
8 pa ȧu-f ḥer χatbu 8. taif ḥemt ȧu-f ḥer χaā-set na en āu ȧu-f ḥems
em kasa en paif sen śerȧu ẖer ȧr em-χet hru qennu ḥer sa enen ȧu paif sen
9 śerȧu em ta ȧnt pa āš 9. ȧu ȧn

### === CORRECTIONS ===

*   **Line 1:** Corrected `neket` to use hill-sign `𓈎` instead of basket `𓎡`. Added reed `𓇋` to start of `emtutu`. Corrected `ṭāt` to use arms `𓂓` instead of snake `𓆓`. Added `𓂋` to all instances of `ḥer`.
*   **Line 2:** Corrected `setef` to use door-bolt `𓋴` instead of pool `𓈙`. Added quail chick `𓅱` to the end of `ḫeperu`.
*   **Line 5:** Corrected the writing of `ṭaṭa-f` (his head) to use the head-sign `𓁶` and stroke `𓏤` instead of the bread-loaf sequence found in the first pass.
*   **Line 6:** Added the missing word `āuṭent` (represented by signs `𓄿 𓅱 𓏏 𓈖 𓏏`). Corrected `ȧri-nef` to use the eye `𓁹` instead of OCR's vulture/crane signs.
*   **Line 7:** Corrected the determinative for `χatbu` (to kill/slay) to the striking man `𓄃` (A14). Corrected suffix in `ȧu-s` (referring to the wife) to the bolt `𓋴` instead of chick `𓆑`.
*   **Line 9:** Added missing word `em-χet` (`𓅓 𓐍 𓏏`). Corrected the word `sa` (back) to the back-with-knot sign `𓐠` (V17).
*   **Line 10:** Corrected the final group: the bracketed missing sign in the text is the reed `𓇋` for the word `ȧu`.

label: The Battle of Kadesh (p.138)
pass1Text:
Expertly transcribing this excerpt from Budge's "Egyptian Reading Book" (1896), page 138, which recounts events from the Battle of Kadesh.

=== HIEROGLYPHS ===
1. 𓅓𓂝𓎛𓃀𓄡 𓆓𓂧 𓇋𓈖 𓍛𓈖𓆑 𓈖 𓋴𓈖 𓎆𓎆𓏽 𓊪𓏏𓂋𓇋𓁹
2. 𓈖 𓈖𓄿𓇋𓏪 𓅓𓂋𓅱𓏪 𓄿𓄿𓄿𓏏 𓈖 𓈖𓄿𓇋𓏪
3. 𓋴𓂋𓅱𓏪 𓈖𓏏𓇋 𓈖𓄿 𓈖𓏏𓇋 𓊪𓄿 𓏏𓄿 𓈖
4. 𓄿𓄿 𓊪𓂋𓏏𓇋 𓋹𓍑𓋴 𓄿𓅓𓆑 𓇋𓂋𓇋 𓋴𓈖
5. 𓄿𓎛𓄿 𓎛𓂋 𓏏𓂧 𓈖 𓄿𓄿 𓊪𓂋𓏏𓇋 𓋹𓍑𓋴 𓅓
6. 𓅓𓈖𓐍𓏏 𓎆𓎆𓏾 𓊪𓄿 𓐍𓂋 𓈖 𓐍𓏏𓄿 𓅓
7. 𓊪𓄿 𓏏𓄿 𓈖 𓐍𓇋𓂋𓃀 𓋴𓅱 𓅱𓄿𓂋 𓂋 𓄛𓄿𓏏 𓍛𓈖𓆑
8. 𓏏𓂋 𓋴𓏏𓅓𓆑 𓂋 𓏏𓂧 𓅓𓄿𓎡 𓏏𓅱𓏏𓅱 𓎆𓎆𓏿 𓐍𓂋
9. 𓇋𓅱 𓐍𓂋 𓋴𓈖 𓎛𓂋 𓏏𓂧 𓈖 𓍛𓈖𓆑 𓅓 𓅓𓈖𓐍𓏏
10. 𓎆𓎆𓏿 𓐍𓂋 𓊪𓏏𓂋𓇋𓁹 𓇋𓂋𓇋 𓄿 𓋴𓏏𓅓 𓅓 𓏏𓄿𓇋
11. 𓅱𓈖𓈖𓅱𓏏 𓅓𓅓𓄿 𓊪𓄿 𓎛𓄿𓊪𓅱𓏏 𓋴𓈖 𓈖 𓊪𓄿
12. 𓏏𓄿 𓈖 𓐍𓏏𓄿 𓂋 𓏏𓂧 𓊪𓄿 𓐍𓂋 𓈖 𓐍𓏏𓄿
13. 𓇋𓅱 𓎛𓈖𓂝 𓋴𓏏 𓄿𓈙𓏏 𓎛𓈖𓂝𓆑 𓅓 𓂋𓂧 𓈖𓃀𓎛
14. 𓎆𓎆𓏿𓏏 𓅓𓄿 𓄿𓈙𓏏 𓋴𓄿 𓋴𓏏 𓄿𓎛𓄿𓅱 𓎛𓄿 𓈎𓂧𓈙
15. 𓏏𓄿 𓄿𓈎𓋴𓏏 𓐍𓂋𓏏𓅱 𓇋𓅱

=== TRANSLITERATION ===
embaḥ ṭeṭ ȧn ḥen-f en sen  24. petrȧ-ten pa seχer en nai meru āuāāt en nai seru enti na enti pa ta en Āa-perti ānx uża senb ȧm-f ȧri-sen āḥā ḥer ṭeṭ en Āa-perti ānx uża senb em menχet  25. pa χer en χeta em pa ta en χireba su uār er ḥāt ḥen-f ṭer setem-f er ṭeṭ māk tutu iu χer sen ḥer ṭeṭ en ḥen-f em menχet  26. χer petrȧ ȧri-ȧ setem em tai unnut emmā pa ḥaput sen en pa ta en χeta er ṭeṭ pa χer en χeta iu ḥnā set āšt ḥnā-f em reθ nebeḥ  27. mā āšt śā set āḥāu ḥa Qeṭeš ta ȧqesit χertu ȧu

embaḥ ṭeṭ ȧn ḥen-f en sen 24. petrȧ-ten pa seχer en nai meru āuāāt en nai seru enti na enti pa ta en Āa-perti ānx uża senb ȧm-f ȧri-sen āḥā ḥer ṭeṭ en Āa-perti ānx uża senb em menχet 25. pa χer en χeta em pa ta en χireba su uār er ḥāt ḥen-f ṭer setem-f er ṭeṭ māk tutu iu χer sen ḥer ṭeṭ en ḥen-f em menχet 26. χer petrȧ ȧri-ȧ setem em tai unnut emmā pa ḥaput sen en pa ta en χeta er ṭeṭ pa χer en χeta iu ḥnā set āšt ḥnā-f em reθ nebeḥ 27. mā āšt śā set āḥāu ḥa Qeṭeš ta ȧqesit χertu ȧu

*   **Line 10:** Corrected `ȧri-ȧ` by changing the vulture (`𓄿`) to an arm sign (`𓂝`) as per the first-person singular suffix visible in the image.
*   **Line 13:** Corrected the rendering of `reθ` from `𓂋𓂧` to `𓂋𓏏𓎛` (mouth, loaf, wick) to match the visual and phonetic value.
*   **Line 14:** Corrected `śā` to duck + bar (`𓅭𓏤`) as rendered in Budge's font.
